name: Box
description: Typed Box API 2.0 files, folders, search, bounded uploads/downloads, versions, comments, collaborations, shared links, users and metadata.

permissions.description: Fixed Box API/upload HTTPS; externally issued OAuth access token. One bounded unauthenticated official download hop. Explicit confirmed mutations can upload, delete, copy, share, comment and change collaboration/metadata. No filesystem, refresh, listeners or retries.

definitions.name: Box List Folder Items
definitions.documentation: Box List Folder Items: GET /2.0/folders/{folderId}/items. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. definitions.name: Box Search Content
definitions.documentation: Box Search Content: GET /2.0/search. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Update file
definitions.documentation: Box Update file: PUT /2.0/files/{fileId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FILE-UPDATE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. definitions.name: Box Upload File
definitions.documentation: Box Upload File: POST /2.0/files/content. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FILE-UPLOAD"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. definitions.name: Box Upload File Version
definitions.documentation: Box Upload File Version: POST /2.0/files/{fileId}/content. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FILE-UPLOAD-VERSION"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. definitions.name: Box List Enterprise Users
definitions.documentation: Box List Enterprise Users: GET /2.0/users. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/
